Living Well / Free resources

Digital privacy & confident use

A useful way in

Choose one place to begin.

Understand everyday settings, recognize suspicious requests, and keep the tools you use aligned with your needs.

Digital confidence comes from a few understandable choices, not from making every possible adjustment. Start with the device or account you already use and the specific concern you are trying to address. Official instructions and independent explanations can help you distinguish a meaningful setting from an impressive-sounding promise.

Start with: Surveillance Self-Defense. Begin with the Basics section or the guide to making a security plan.

Keep the context

Take what is useful, thoughtfully.

These links provide education, not a security audit of your devices. Provider guidance is specific to its products, and settings can change. Preserve recovery options and essential access before changing an account. Never paste passwords, recovery codes, or private records into a public exercise or an AI conversation.

Selections are based on public source review, not a claim that Nolan uses every resource or belongs to the organizations listed.
